cast.name: Patricia Campbell
cast.role: protagonist — suburban housewife, book club founder, the one who sees the monster first
cast.look: White woman in her late thirties, medium build, shoulder-length brown hair pinned back, wearing a floral print dress with an apron, tired eyes, 1990s suburban mother

cast.name: James Harris
cast.role: antagonist — the vampire, a charming Southern gentleman who feeds on the invisible
cast.look: Tall, lean white man in his early forties, dark slicked-back hair, sharp jaw, immaculate navy blazer over a crisp white shirt, unsettlingly polished smile, 1990s real estate investor look

cast.name: Carter Campbell
cast.role: Patricia's husband — ambitious psychiatrist, sides with James over his own wife
cast.look: White man in his early forties, tall athletic build, neat sandy-brown hair parted to the side, wire-rimmed glasses, wearing a button-down shirt with rolled sleeves, doctor's confidence

cast.name: Mrs. Green
cast.role: moral center — elderly Black domestic worker who sees the truth and has survived real monsters
cast.look: Elderly Black woman in her late sixties, small sturdy build, short gray hair under a headscarf, wearing a simple housedress, weathered hands, fierce clear eyes

cast.name: Slick Paley
cast.role: book club member — terrified of her husband finding out what they read, dies in hospital
cast.look: White woman in her late thirties, slim build, highlighted blonde bob, wearing a pastel polo shirt and khaki shorts, tennis bracelet, country club suburban wife

cast.name: Grace
cast.role: book club member — called out by Mrs. Green for protecting herself but not the children of Six Mile
cast.look: White woman in her early forties, stocky build, reddish-brown curly hair, wearing a cardigan over a blouse, reading glasses on a chain around her neck

cast.name: Everyman
cast.role: generic stand-in for unnamed people, neighbors, children
cast.look: Nondescript adult, neutral clothing, used when no specific character is on screen
